# MDL204 · `malformed-table-group`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A group looks like a table section but is not written ``[`db`.`table`]``.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | groups |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | unsafe |
| Design references | F7 |

## Why

mydumper only treats a group as a table section when its name starts with a backtick, contains `` `.` `` and ends with a backtick: ``[`db`.`table`]``, ``[`db`.``]`` (every table of db) or ``[``.`table`]``. [db.table] or ``[`db.table`]`` are ignored, with their `where`, `rows` and masking settings: the masked columns are dumped in plaintext.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[db.users]
`email`=random_string
[`db.orders`]
where=amount > 0
[db.a.b]
rows=10
```

```text
1:2-1:10 error MDL204[malformed-table-group] [db.users] is not a table section: write it [`db`.`table`], each name in backticks
  = mydumper ignores this section: its where, rows and masking settings do not apply. The masked columns are dumped in plaintext.
  fix (unsafe): Rename the section to [`db`.`users`]
3:2-3:13 error MDL204[malformed-table-group] [`db.orders`] is not a table section: write it [`db`.`table`], each name in backticks
  = mydumper ignores this section: its where, rows and masking settings do not apply.
  fix (unsafe): Rename the section to [`db`.`orders`]
5:2-5:8 error MDL204[malformed-table-group] [db.a.b] is not a table section: write it [`db`.`table`], each name in backticks
  = mydumper ignores this section: its where, rows and masking settings do not apply.
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix --unsafe-fixes`:

```ini
[`db`.`users`]
`email`=random_string
[`db`.`orders`]
where=amount > 0
[db.a.b]
rows=10
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL204: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL204` on the line above it.
